name: oc-servicios
description: Sistema de seguimiento de servicios de mantenimiento de talleres

scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:backend:prod" "wait-on -l -t 120s tcp:127.0.0.1:5001 && npm run preview:frontend"
scripts.dev:prod-like: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=5001 npm run dev:backend" "wait-on -l -t 120s tcp:127.0.0.1:5001 && npm run preview:frontend"
scripts.dev:hot: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
